verdict.rationale: Zep is a SaaS context and memory layer that ingests user data and runs LLM processing, so a no-training guarantee or opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions model-training use, opt-outs or training exclusions. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct: RTBF user deletion, graph edge and node deletion, ABAC/RBAC access controls, audit logs, and VPC deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
